tools.name: call2me_profile
tools.description: Safe summary of the connected Call2Me account: email, name, account type. NEVER returns the API key. Use when the user asks which account they are connected to.

tools.name: call2me_list_agents
tools.description: Lists the voice assistants on the account. Use when the user wants to see their assistants, or needs to pick one for another operation.

tools.name: call2me_get_agent
tools.description: Full settings for a single assistant: language, voice, system prompt, model.

tools.name: call2me_list_calls
tools.description: Lists past calls: direction, duration, status, number. Pass agent_id to restrict to one assistant.

tools.name: call2me_get_call
tools.description: Details of a single call: start and end, duration, status, cost.

tools.name: call2me_get_call_transcript
tools.description: Returns the conversation transcript in vCon format — who said what, with timestamps. Use when the user asks what was said on a call.

tools.name: call2me_list_phone_numbers
tools.description: Lists the phone numbers on the account and which assistant each one is bound to.

tools.name: call2me_list_schedules
tools.description: Lists scheduled calls: when, which number, which assistant.

tools.name: call2me_get_wallet
tools.description: Current account balance in USD, the same wallet that calls and numbers draw on.

tools.name: call2me_list_interpreters
tools.description: Lists the live interpreters on the account: name, language pair, bound number. An interpreter connects two people who each speak their own language, translating in real time.

tools.name: call2me_get_interpreter
tools.description: Settings for a single interpreter: language pair, voice, transparency mode, phone number, browser session link.

tools.name: call2me_list_interpreter_calls
tools.description: Lists sessions run through an interpreter: duration, languages, status.

tools.name: call2me_get_interpreter_web_status
tools.description: Shows who is currently connected to the interpreter browser session.

tools.name: call2me_list_allowed_countries
tools.description: Countries where a phone number can be purchased. Use before searching numbers to see which countries are open.

tools.name: call2me_search_numbers
tools.description: Lists purchasable phone numbers in a country. DOES NOT BUY — it only shows them. The country code is required; do not guess it, ask the user or call call2me_list_allowed_countries first.

tools.name: call2me_get_pricing
tools.description: Per-minute call rates and number prices.

tools.name: call2me_list_knowledge_bases
tools.description: Lists the knowledge bases (documents the assistants can search during calls). Pass agent_id to restrict to one assistant.

tools.name: call2me_get_knowledge_base
tools.description: Details of one knowledge base: name, status and its sources.

tools.name: call2me_query_knowledge_base
tools.description: Runs a semantic search over one knowledge base and returns the best matching passages. Use to test what an assistant would retrieve.

tools.name: call2me_list_widgets
tools.description: Lists website chat/voice widgets. Pass agent_id to restrict to one assistant.

tools.name: call2me_get_widget
tools.description: Full widget settings plus the ready-to-paste embed code (script tag) for the user's website.

tools.name: call2me_list_chats
tools.description: Lists text chat sessions with assistants. Pass agent_id to restrict to one assistant.

tools.name: call2me_get_chat
tools.description: Returns one chat session with its full message history.

tools.name: call2me_get_schedule
tools.description: Details of one scheduled call: time, timezone, status, recurrence.

tools.name: call2me_get_agent_stats
tools.description: Call statistics for one assistant (volume, duration, success) over a period.

tools.name: call2me_get_call_recording
tools.description: Returns a temporary signed URL (valid about 1 hour) for a call's audio recording.

tools.name: call2me_list_voices
tools.description: Lists available text-to-speech voices; use a voice id when creating or updating an assistant. Filter by language, provider or gender.

tools.name: call2me_list_sip_trunks
tools.description: Lists the account's SIP trunks. Passwords are never returned.

tools.name: call2me_list_sms
tools.description: Lists sent and received SMS messages.

tools.name: call2me_list_transactions
tools.description: Lists wallet transactions (top-ups, call charges, number fees).

tools.name: call2me_get_usage_analytics
tools.description: Spending and usage analytics for the wallet over a period.

tools.name: call2me_get_auto_charge
tools.description: Shows the wallet auto top-up settings: enabled, threshold and charge amount.

tools.name: call2me_get_webhook
tools.description: Shows the account webhook URL and whether a signing secret is set. The secret itself is never returned.

tools.name: call2me_list_notification_targets
tools.description: Lists post-call notification targets (email, SMS, WhatsApp, webhook) of one assistant.

tools.name: call2me_create_agent
tools.description: Creates a new voice assistant. Do not call it unless the user asks explicitly; do not invent fields such as name and language — ask.

tools.name: call2me_update_agent
tools.description: Changes an existing assistant. Send only the fields the user named explicitly. Other API fields are accepted too, notably: knowledge_base_ids (attach knowledge bases), post_call_actions and post_call_extraction (post-call automation), voice_id, webhook_url, transfer_targets, begin_message, enable_re

tools.name: call2me_create_schedule
tools.description: Schedules a call for a given time. This WILL produce a REAL call — the target number is dialled when the time comes. agent_id, phone_number and scheduled_at are REQUIRED; never guess any of them, ask the user if anything is missing.

tools.name: call2me_create_interpreter
tools.description: Creates a new live interpreter. name, source language and target language are REQUIRED — never guess any of them, ask the user.

tools.name: call2me_update_interpreter
tools.description: Changes an existing interpreter. Send only the fields the user named explicitly.

tools.name: call2me_enable_interpreter_web
tools.description: Opens or closes the browser session link for an interpreter. Does NOT place a phone call.

tools.name: call2me_create_interpreter_passcode
tools.description: Mints a single-use join passcode for the browser session.

tools.name: call2me_bind_number
tools.description: Binds a phone number to an assistant, which then answers calls to that number. Replaces any existing binding.

tools.name: call2me_checkout_number
tools.description: Creates a checkout link for buying a number. DOES NOT BUY and DOES NOT CHARGE — the user confirms on the payment screen themselves. Use this path when the balance is insufficient.

tools.name: call2me_create_voice_session
tools.description: Opens a browser voice session and returns connection details. Does NOT place a phone call.

tools.name: call2me_create_knowledge_base
tools.description: Creates a knowledge base from text and/or URLs. To make an assistant use it, pass agent_id here (auto-links), or add the id to the assistant's knowledge_base_ids via call2me_update_agent. Provide at least one text or URL.

tools.name: call2me_add_knowledge_base_sources
tools.description: Adds text and/or URL sources to an existing knowledge base.

tools.name: call2me_create_widget
tools.description: Creates a website chat widget for an assistant. Returns the embed code.

tools.name: call2me_update_widget
tools.description: Changes widget settings. Send only the fields the user named.

tools.name: call2me_start_chat
tools.description: Starts a text chat session with an assistant and returns session_id. Starting is free; each message sent with call2me_send_chat_message is billed.

tools.name: call2me_update_schedule
tools.description: Changes a scheduled call (time, timezone, contact name, recurrence). Send only the fields the user named.

tools.name: call2me_duplicate_agent
tools.description: Creates a copy of an assistant with the same settings.

tools.name: call2me_create_sip_trunk
tools.description: Registers a SIP trunk (the user's own telephony provider). The password is stored but never returned. Calls may be routed through this server: Confirm the exact destination/value with the user first.

tools.name: call2me_register_phone_number
tools.description: Registers a phone number the user already owns together with the user's own SIP trunk (trunk_id is required). Does NOT buy a number. Never invent the number. Confirm the exact destination/value with the user first.

tools.name: call2me_create_topup_link
tools.description: Creates a payment link for adding credit. It does NOT pay: the user must open the link and pay. Never invent the amount; ask the user.

tools.name: call2me_set_webhook
tools.description: Sets or replaces the account webhook URL (events are POSTed there). The signing secret is never returned; supply your own webhook_secret if you need to know it, otherwise one is generated and hidden. All call events will be sent to this URL: Confirm the exact destination/value with the user first.

tools.name: call2me_create_notification_target
tools.description: Adds a post-call notification (email, SMS, WhatsApp or custom URL) to an assistant. Messages will be sent to the destination after calls; never invent the destination. Confirm the exact destination/value with the user first.

tools.name: call2me_make_outbound_call
tools.description: Places a REAL phone call: the target number is dialled IMMEDIATELY and charged. Cannot be undone. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a call to be placed. agent_id and to_number are REQUIRED — never guess either one, never infer it from earlier conversation and never assign a default. A

tools.name: call2me_end_call
tools.description: Cuts off a call in progress IMMEDIATELY. Cannot be undone — the conversation ends.

tools.name: call2me_delete_agent
tools.description: PERMANENTLY deletes an assistant. Cannot be undone. If it is unclear which assistant is meant, NEVER guess — ask the user.

tools.name: call2me_start_interpreter_call
tools.description: Places a REAL phone call: the target number is dialled IMMEDIATELY, both sides are connected through live translation, and the call is charged. Cannot be undone. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks. interpreter_id and target_number are REQUIRED — never guess either one.

tools.name: call2me_purchase_number
tools.description: BUYS a phone number: the balance IS CHARGED and monthly rent starts. Cannot be undone. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks to buy and has picked the number themselves. NEVER guess the number — show options with call2me_search_numbers first and let the user choose. If the balance is insuffic

tools.name: call2me_release_number
tools.description: PERMANENTLY releases a phone number: it leaves the account, may be reassigned to someone else, and cannot be recovered. Incoming calls stop.

tools.name: call2me_unbind_number
tools.description: Removes the number's assistant binding; calls to it are no longer answered. The number stays on the account.

tools.name: call2me_delete_interpreter
tools.description: PERMANENTLY deletes an interpreter. Cannot be undone. If it is unclear which one is meant, NEVER guess — ask the user.

tools.name: call2me_end_interpreter_web
tools.description: Cuts off the browser session in progress IMMEDIATELY. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: call2me_cancel_schedule
tools.description: Cancels a scheduled call. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: call2me_delete_knowledge_base
tools.description: PERMANENTLY deletes a knowledge base and its sources. Cannot be undone. Confirm with the user first; never guess which one.

tools.name: call2me_delete_widget
tools.description: PERMANENTLY deletes a widget; embedded copies stop working. Cannot be undone. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: call2me_send_chat_message
tools.description: Sends a message in a chat session and returns the assistant's reply. Each message is BILLED (about $0.01). Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: call2me_delete_sip_trunk
tools.description: PERMANENTLY deletes a SIP trunk; numbers on it stop working. Cannot be undone. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: call2me_send_sms
tools.description: Sends a REAL, charged SMS. Needs the sender number (one the account owns), the recipient and the text. Never invent numbers; confirm with the user first.

tools.name: call2me_delete_notification_target
tools.description: Removes a post-call notification target. Cannot be undone. Confirm with the user first.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: call2me_get_call_transcript, call2me_list_widgets, call2me_list_chats, call2me_get_chat, call2me_get_call_recording, call2me_list_sms, call2me_get_webhook, call2me_list_notification_targets · Private data: call2me_profile, call2me_get_wallet, call2me_list_knowledge_bases, call2me_list_sip_trunks, call2me_list_transactions, call2me_get_usage_analytics, call2me_get_auto_charge, call2me_get_webhook, call2me_update_schedule, call2me_create_sip_trunk, call2me_set_webhook · Public sink: call2me_profile, call2me_list_sms, call2me_get_webhook, call2me_list_notification_targets, call2me_update_agent, call2me_update_interpreter, call2me_update_widget, call2me_update_schedule, call2me_set_webhook, call2me_create_notification_target, call2me_send_chat_message, call2me_send_sms, call2me_delete_notification_target · Destructive: call2me_get_call_transcript, call2me_list_interpreter_calls, call2me_delete_agent, call2me_delete_interpreter, call2me_delete_knowledge_base, call2me_delete_widget, call2me_delete_sip_trunk, call2me_delete_notification_target.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "call2me_list_campaigns" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "call2me_update_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Changes an existing assistant. Send only the fields the user named explicitly." → after: "Changes an existing assistant. Send only the fields the user named explicitly. Other API fields are accepted too, notably: knowledge_base_ids (attach knowledge bases), post_call_actions and post_call_extraction (post-call automation), voice_id, webhook_url, transfer_targets, begin_message, enable_re"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
